recommended_live_input_schema.append_only: New discovery/review appends a new observation. Existing source and emitted decisions retain their original knowledge cutoff; retrospective research requires separately named vintage mode.

selection_rules: At decision date, select latest disclosed annual FY and latest disclosed edition for that FY, including metadata-only pending filings; latest pending blocks old report carry. H1/Q1 never silently replaces annual operands.

Bind the six original annual operands from one same-report contract; mean assets requires its independent closing/opening roles. Jan1 fiscal-opening label stays literal and is not falsely described as an originally printed Dec31.

Same-day differing report/record identity is pending unless explicit supersession is source-bound; no amount-good tie break. Later full-year revision resets effective source version only after accepted availability.
Later notice or H1 comparison that changes relevant prior FY fiscal operands remains pending. Do not clear policy/consolidation/restatement barriers because amounts match or missing flags are empty.
Known scope-unrelated exact event may be exempted only for its bound source and field-period contract; exemption is not issuer-wide. Review all remaining known events, not just first blocker.

Late discovery cannot rewrite a previously emitted decision or pretend original live availability. Store public availability separately from accepted local knowledge and fail closed on unverified time/coverage.

Use source coverage watermark and expiry. At present metadata queries end2026-10-09, calendar references cover actual dates through10/08 and10/12 is planned/unverified; two old proposal dates alone cannot prove current complete/latest.

Construct G source cohort independently of AR/INV and F141. Rank G within G-qualified dated sectors first, then intersect finite F for GF. This may change historical cohort versus old frozen artifact; never overwrite its backtest/rank values.
If source refresh fails or expires, mark source_pending without numeric zero or forward-fill beyond validated coverage; source failures are not economic failures/investigation exhaustion.
production_channel_limit: Local dynamic store/provider and source refresh do not prove PandaAI Factor runtime can read/update that store. Static SOURCE upload and finite projection cannot automatically serve future live decisions; exact platform-supported dynamic field/period/public-time contract or authenticated source refresh channel remains separate.
